redRun.detail: The original BFF did not expose lifecycle signals or a server timeout, did not abort the downstream stream, and accepted source end without a terminal result.

verifiedAssertions: The BFF owns a fixed server timeout and callers cannot raise it through the stream request.
Explicit cancellation and verified transport disconnect are converted to distinct fail-closed terminal errors.
One internal AbortSignal is passed to Product Core for cancellation of pending downstream work.
A lifecycle stop is checked before resuming the downstream iterator and again before any event is yielded.
COMPLETED or FAILED is released only after Product Core ends the stream; missing or post-terminal events fail closed.
Each injected interruption aborted the downstream stream and left the delayed Synthetic Tool or Connector side-effect counter at zero.
limitations: This supplement verifies lifecycle propagation through the public C01 BFF and a Synthetic in-process Product Core port; it is not a browser, reverse-proxy, network or production soak test.

The fault fixture proves zero delayed Synthetic side effects only for a downstream implementation that honors the supplied AbortSignal; production Tool and Connector runtimes require their own cancellation, lease and idempotency acceptance.
The 20 millisecond timeout is a deterministic test configuration; the source default is 30000 milliseconds and is not a production SLO approval.
This supplement does not change any recorded P1 status, reopen or approve G1, enter P2, or authorize P3 enterprise integration.
